question: Which current-image paths implement UEA 1 Roads cost half as much, and do the reusable cost result and city-update command path apply the same arithmetic?

scope.boundary: This packet identifies the shared UEA 1 halving arithmetic in one reusable cost-return helper and the city-update command path. It does not name the path-factor helper, recover every base-cost input, prove every road action or caller, identify command 7 beyond this bounded use, or establish AI, presentation, save, scenario, multiplayer, or runtime behavior.

dependencies.use: Provides the accepted cumulative ActiveCivilizationBonusLookup contract and three retail placements of UEA 1.

baseCostShape.qualification: Both accepted paths use this exact integer shape before UEA 1. The factor-helper meaning, all inputs, and the bounded scalar's complete provenance remain unresolved.

costOwner.activeResult: signed base cost divided by two with truncation toward zero
costOwner.result: The reusable helper returns half of the composed signed road cost when cumulative UEA 1 is active and the full cost otherwise.

cityUpdateConsumer.result: The city-update path applies the identical signed half-cost arithmetic, then uses the resulting value in its positive and affordability checks before the bounded command-7 submission.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only current-image query with two 25-word windows, exact verification of 29 selected words and branch targets, and narrow generated-code corroboration of 0x82CF83C0 and the road-cost slice in 0x82D13978.
currentEvidence.qualification: No runtime action was performed. The current-image windows establish both lookup gates and half-cost arithmetic; generated code supplies bounded base composition and downstream command-use context.

guards: Do not replace signed division toward zero with an unsigned shift or floating-point half.

conclusion: RoadBuildCostLookup at 0x82CF83C0 and the bounded city-update path in 0x82D13978 independently compose the same road base-cost shape, request cumulative UEA 1, and divide the signed cost by two with truncation toward zero when active. The city-update result feeds its affordability check before command 7 is submitted.
